description: Story 36.6 AC3: npm test chain files known to fail on Linux (ubuntu-latest, Node 22, uv 0.13.8, Python 3.11), each failing identically at 38ea256 (run https://github.com/mayafit/AI_Agents/actions/runs/43655069772).
